  computing. They are used to administer servers, automate builds, inspect logs, manage
  containers, and connect tools in repeatable workflows. Newer shells, including fish,
  emphasize discoverability and user-friendly defaults, while PowerShell applies shell
  concepts to a different programming and system-management tradition.

  Across these generations, the shell has balanced two roles: a quick place to issue commands
  and a language for expressing repeatable work. Each influential shell added ideas that
  users came to expect, from scripting and pipelines to history and completion. The result is
  not one universal shell, but a family of interpreters shaped by different needs. Unix
  shells endure because they make programs composable and let people turn a sequence of
  commands into a tool of their own.
